description:
Keeps the screen on for a chosen time, and adjusts the brightness
Héméra has two functions, one tab each.

Time: keeps the screen on for the time you choose, then hands back to the phone's own sleep delay.

* Default: the phone decides, as usual
* 30 min or 1 h
* Custom: from 5 min to 12 h, remembered for next time
* Endless: until it is stopped

Light: adjusts the brightness, right in the app or with an optional slider on the edge of the screen, over other apps.

* Edge slider: 13 positions, adjustable size, color and visibility, long press for automatic brightness
* Calibration to match the phone's own brightness slider (each manufacturer uses its own curve)

Also:

* Two quick settings tiles: cycle through the modes, show or hide the edge slider
* Shortcuts on the app icon for each mode
* Notification with the time left, the end time and a Stop button
* Available in English and French

It is named after Hemera, the Greek goddess of day, who drives the night away: the longer the mode, the brighter the day on screen.

How it works: Héméra never changes the sleep delay. It places an invisible 1-pixel window that keeps the screen on: if the app stops, the phone goes back to normal on its own. Locking the phone stops the mode.

Permissions: display over other apps (to keep the screen on and show the edge slider), modify system settings (brightness only), notifications, run at startup (to show the edge slider again if it is on; a mode never restarts on its own).

Free and open source: no account, no ads, no trackers, no Internet access.
